passive.name: Transcendent
passive.text: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional chargeForce of Will: Bonus true damage.Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targetsUnleashed Power: Executes low health targets

spells.name: Dark Sphere
spells.text: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

spells.name: Force of Will
spells.text: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

spells.name: Scatter the Weak
spells.text: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

spells.name: Unleashed Power
spells.text: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

damage.value: Syndra deals magic burst damage rather than sustained damage.

archetype.value: Syndra is a burst mage who locks down vulnerable targets and damages them from range.

axis.value: Syndra plays lane as a bully who pokes from afar.

winCondition.value: Syndra wins by locking down vulnerable targets and following up with a burst of damage.

spikes.why: Syndra becomes stronger as she gains access to her passive’s buffs and gets past her weak early stages.
Syndra relies on items to deliver her damage effectively.
Syndra's high damage makes her a threat even when an enemy has plenty of health.

bait.why: After Syndra spends Scatter the Weak, its 15-second cooldown leaves her without its knockback and sphere-triggered stun.

mistakes.value: Syndra struggles when poor positioning leaves her exposed while her spells are on cooldown.
